text:
A plastic rod is rubbed with a dry woollen cloth. The rod becomes positively charged.
Which statement is correct?
A
Electrons move from the cloth to the rod.
B
Electrons move from the rod to the cloth.
C
Protons move from the cloth to the rod.
D
Protons move from the rod to the cloth.

options.label: A
options.text: Electrons move from the cloth to the rod.

options.label: B
options.text: Electrons move from the rod to the cloth.

options.label: C
options.text: Protons move from the cloth to the rod.

options.label: D
options.text: Protons move from the rod to the cloth.
